description: The first Il-14 of the 919th Air Transport Regiment, a gift of the Soviet government to President Ho Chi Minh and fitted out as his VIP aircraft with a bed and work desk. Operated in Hang Khong Viet Nam civil markings. In August 2025 it was trucked overnight to the National Exhibition Centre for the '80 nam hanh trinh Doc lap - Tu do - Hanh phuc' exhibition; it is normally displayed at the Aviation Museum. A 2012 photograph of this aircraft is filed on Wikimedia Commons under the Air Force Museum category, which appears to be a mis-categorisation.
An-2 of the 919th Air Transport Regiment; the museum credits this aircraft with sinking a US commando vessel off Sam Son, Thanh Hoa on 7 March 1966. Number displayed as 670.C.
